-- GO is a signal recognized by SSMS,
-- sqlcmd, and other CLIENT TOOLS.
-- The SQL Server engine itself
-- never sees the word GO.
caption: It marks a batch boundary — nothing more.
A variable only lives for the batch that declared it — GO starts a NEW batch.

eyebrow: Why every script opens with USE ... ; GO
caption: Ensures the database-context switch completes as its own batch first.
